findings.description:
Reentrancy in EtherStore.withdrawFunds(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_037.sol#20-30):
	External calls:
	- require(bool)(msg.sender.call.value(_weiToWithdraw)()) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_037.sol#27)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balances[msg.sender] -= _weiToWithdraw (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_037.sol#28)
	EtherStore.balances (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_037.sol#14) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- EtherStore.depositFunds() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_037.sol#16-18)
	- EtherStore.withdrawFunds(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_037.sol#20-30)
	- lastWithdrawTime[msg.sender] = now (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_037.sol#29)
	EtherStore.lastWithdrawTime (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_037.sol#13) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- EtherStore.withdrawFunds(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_037.sol#20-30)

EtherStore.withdrawFunds(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_037.sol#20-30) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- require(bool)(now >= lastWithdrawTime[msg.sender] + 604800) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_037.sol#25)
